I thinking of packages such as VRCFury that do not have a consistent Stable and are always at risk for updates, and would be happy to be able to update them all together with a check box selection.

As VCC issue be dealing on GitHub, relative issue are as follow.

comments.mergedPostDetails: as simple as it sound, sometime it's kind of a pain to update one by one every component, it can take you a bit, mostly if you have many packages, a button that will update all packages would make it much easier
comments.mergedPostTitle: A single Button to Update all Packages
comments.value: I was just coming on here to see if someone else has posted this and I'm surprised there's not more posts about this. It's a massive pain just sitting and waiting for the packages to update and because I have to do them one at a time, I have to sit there and actually wait. It's a huge waste of time when I should just be able to hit "update all" and do something else in the meantime.
Any update on this? it's especially needed now because of how many creators use their own packages now. There's nothing I dread more than to open a project and see this (Attached Image)
any updates on this?  Getting really frustrating having 20-30 packages that need updating...Even if you can pick the order of updating.  Just some automation would be awesome.
